assessments.zone: Rural villages of Kasongo, Samba and Kunda secteurs west of ~26.95E (Lualaba valley, Kasongo-Kunda and Kasongo-Samba axes)
assessments.evidence: No armed group is known to administer villages in the central and western part of the territory; thin state presence (PNC posts, chiefs under territorial administration) is assumed. Web research could not be performed for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/reference sites egress-blocked); assessment rests on default state presence and background knowledge.

assessments.zone: Eastern and northern fringe toward Kabambare and Pangi territories (villages east of ~26.95E, and far-northern Kunda villages near Kampene)
assessments.evidence: Remote villages bordering Kabambare territory (where Mai-Mai Malaika have been active around Salamabila) and Pangi; no specific report of armed-group control here was found, so thin state presence is assumed with low confidence. Web research could not be performed for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/reference sites egress-blocked); assessment rests on default state presence and background knowledge.

assessments.zone: Secondary centres: Kipaka Centre (Kunda secteur), Samba cite and Mission Celpa/Scimema's/Milowe area (Samba secteur), Bwana Mdogo, Kunda health-zone centres
assessments.evidence: Larger secondary towns along the Kasongo-Kindu and Kasongo-Kibombo/Samba axes with secteur administration and PNC posts; no reported armed-group control. Web research could not be performed for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/reference sites egress-blocked); assessment rests on default state presence and background knowledge.

assessments.zone: Kasongo town (territorial seat) and its health-area neighbourhoods Mufala, Maringa, Limanga, Km 18, Kauta, plus Kasongo Rive on the Lualaba
assessments.evidence: Kasongo is the seat of the territorial administration of Kasongo territory (Maniema), far west of the Kivu frontlines; no armed group is known to hold or administer the town, which is policed by the PNC with territorial authorities, ANR and FARDC elements present. Web research could not be performed for this unit (search budget exhausted, news/reference sites egress-blocked); assessment rests on default state presence and background knowledge.

units.CD6311-kasongo: Kasongo territory (Maniema) lies west of the eastern Kivu frontlines and no armed group is known to hold or administer any of its secteurs (Kasongo, Kunda, Samba) as of the reference date. Kasongo town is assessed as PNC-policed with territorial administration, ANR and some FARDC presence; secondary centres (Kipaka, Samba, Mission Celpa, Bwana Mdogo) likewise. Rural villages are assumed under thin state presence. The eastern fringe toward Kabambare (Mai-Mai Malaika area around Salamabila) and the northern fringe toward Pangi carry lower confidence. Web research could not be performed for this unit (search budget exhausted, sites egress-blocked), so the assessment rests on default state presence and background knowledge.
